content.title: KSB 401-2829 Self-Priming AODD Diaphragm Pump, 1 in Inlet/Outlet, Polypropylene Wetted Parts
content.short_description: KSB 401-2829 is a self-priming air-operated double diaphragm (AODD) pump with 1 in inlet and outlet ports and polypropylene wetted components.
content.long_description:
The KSB 401-2829 is an air-operated double diaphragm (AODD) pump designed for self-priming operation, allowing it to draw fluid without the need for a flooded suction line. The pump features 1 in inlet and 1 in outlet connections, suitable for fluid transfer applications requiring compact port sizing.

Wetted components are constructed from polypropylene, a material selection relevant for compatibility with a range of process fluids. As an AODD pump, the unit operates using compressed air to alternately actuate two diaphragms, moving fluid through the pump body without reliance on electric power at the point of use.

MPN 401-2829 falls under KSB's industrial pump offering within the Fluid Handling category. Procurement and maintenance teams should confirm process fluid compatibility with polypropylene and verify port sizing against existing piping before installation.
